subject: E-Commerce
title: Guest Checkout Saves Sales
description: One-minute skill: Guest Checkout Saves Sales.

hook.text: Forcing account creation before checkout kills 24% of sales. That's almost 1 in 4 customers gone forever.

buildup.text: Companies want account data for marketing. But the friction of creating a password drives people away.

discovery.text: Guest checkout lets people buy without signing up. Conversion rates jump 45% when guest checkout is added.

twist.text: Smart stores ask for an account AFTER purchase: 'Save your info for next time?' Post-purchase, people say yes.

climax.text: The lesson: never put barriers before the sale. Get the money first, then build the relationship.

punchline.text: 45% more sales with guest checkout. Remove the wall, get the sale, then ask.

quiz.question: When is the best time to ask customers to create an account?
